items.headline: Love-Watson connection helps Packers take some revenge on Bears with a 31-7 rout
items.description: — Christian Watson caught two long touchdown passes from Jordan Love, MarShawn Lloyd also scored twice and the Green Bay Packers exacted a measure of revenge against the Chicago Bears by trouncing them 31-7 on Sunday.

items.description: The Bears have ruled RB Kyle Monangai out for Sunday's matchup against the Packers, while QB Caleb Williams is questionable after being a limited participant in Friday's practice.
